headline: Average pension in Poland. ZUS shows latest data
summary: Poland had 7.47 million pensioners in 2025, up 1.1% year on year. The average pension rose 8.2% to 4,178.94 zloty, according to GUS data.
why: Pension levels affect household consumption and the public finance burden in Poland. The Central Statistical Office (GUS) publishes these official figures.
original_headline: Średnia emerytura w Polsce. ZUS pokazuje najnowsze dane
